en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from someone else, from his companion, from Aban Bin Usman, from Zurara who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘They came to Ali<sup>asws</sup> with a boy who had stolen. So he<sup>asws</sup> scratched his fingers, then said: ‘But, if you were to repeat, I would cut these’.
Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But it has not been done except by Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and myself<sup>asws</sup>’.
